title: Enable service delivery resources
goal: Whoever delivers can run a live offer's procedure without the founder beside them: the plan says who must learn what, the materials sit beside the runbook, and nobody works a client's deliverable before passing the test for its skills.

steps.do: Write, for each live offer, who must be able to run its procedure (the founder, a named agent, a named supplier), what each of them must be able to do unaided, and in what order it is learned, on the handoff.

Turn each offer's procedure into what someone can learn from (the runbook with its checks, one worked example from a closed engagement with the client's identifying details removed, and the list of mistakes already made) and point the offer's runbook at it.
Put each performer's learning into dated slots that collide with no committed deliverable, and open one handoff per session with what it must leave the person able to do.

consider.why: Dates stop learning from being pushed behind client work for ever.
consider.when: Someone other than the founder is to work a client's deliverable.

steps.do: Prepare the session on how the work runs (opening an engagement, recording status and evidence, raising a change request, who may speak to the client) with its exercises, and leave giving the session to the founder.

consider.why: Teaching a person is the founder's, and the agent can only prepare what is taught.
consider.when: A new performer is to work a client's deliverable.

steps.do: Prepare the session on the craft of one offer, with its tools, its data and two exercises taken from a closed engagement whose answer is already known, and leave giving it to the founder or to the agent that holds the skill.

consider.why: The craft of an offer is the part a runbook cannot carry on its own.
consider.when: A new performer is to work a deliverable of an offer they have not delivered before.

steps.do: Set the test for each skill as a task from a closed engagement judged by its own acceptance test, record who attempted it, the result and the date on the handoff, and name who may not yet take a client's deliverable.

consider.why: A test on work whose answer is known is how the venture finds out before a client does.
consider.when: Someone other than the founder is to work a client's deliverable.

steps.do: After the next delivery by a trained performer, compare its rework, hours and on-time result with earlier deliveries of the same offer and say plainly whether the training changed anything.

consider.why: Training that changes no delivery figure is cost without a result.
consider.when: A trained performer has delivered at least one deliverable of the offer they were trained on.

steps.do: Add what the plan and the tests showed to the decisions they bear on, and recommend to the product lead which skill to build, buy or stop offering.

done_criteria.check: Does every live offer have materials someone could learn it from, and has every performer other than the founder passed the test for the skills their assigned deliverables need?
